intro v
obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.asIdeal_injective.mp (v.asIdeal)
have hp_prime : p.IsPrime := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.prime v
have hp_maximal : p.IsMaximal := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.isMaximal v
have h_ne_zero : p ≠ 0 := by contrapose! hp_maximal.2
have h_norm_pos : 0 < Ideal.absNorm p := by
  rw [Ideal.absNorm]
  exact (Ideal.norm_pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h_ne_zero)
have h_norm_ge_1 : Ideal.absNorm p ≥ 1 :=
  by rw [Ideal.absNorm]; exact Nat.zero_le_one
have h_norm_lt_1 : ¬(Ideal.absNorm p < 1) :=
  by intro h; rw [Ideal.absNorm] at h; exact lt_irrefl (Ideal.absNorm p) h
have h_norm_eq_1 : Ideal.absNorm p = 1 :=
  by rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h_norm_ge_1 with (h | h)
  · exact Eq.refl 1
  · exact false.elim h_norm_lt_1 h
exact h_norm_eq_1
